page.overview:
Who is Lewis Dodgson?

Adam Harrington(Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous/) Campbell Scott()

Head of Research for Biosyn (Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous) CEO of Biosyn (Jurassic World: Chaos Theory/Jurassic World: Dominion)

Dr. Lewis Dodgson was the main antagonist of the Jurassic Park franchise, serving as the overarching antagonist of , Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous Season 5 and Jurassic World: Chaos Theory, and the main antagonist of . In Chaos Theory, he serves as the unseen overarching antagonist of season 2, the overarching antagonist of season 3, and the main antagonist of season 4.

He was the scientist that hired Dennis Nedry to steal dinosaur embryos from Jurassic Park. He made his return 29 years later as the CEO of Biosyn with mysterious and evil ambitions.
